title: FizzBuzz
statement:
Given an integer N, print numbers from 1 to N with the following rules:
- If a number is divisible by both 3 and 5, print "FizzBuzz".
- If a number is divisible by only 3, print "Fizz".
- If a number is divisible by only 5, print "Buzz".
- Otherwise, print the number itself.
inputFormat: A single line containing one integer N.
outputFormat: N lines, one for each number from 1 to N following the rules above.

examples.explanation: 3 is divisible by 3 → Fizz, 5 is divisible by 5 → Buzz.
